title: CASE-SPH-LAKE-AT-REST: Resolution Ladder (Periodic Tank)
summary: Measured the convergence of interior-band profile errors for the lake-at-rest case in the laterally periodic tank at dx=0.04 and dx=0.02. Density error converges at order ~1.5 (7.17e-04 → 2.53e-04), pressure error at ~1.5 (9.93e-02 → 3.48e-02). Both equilibrium components remain at machine precision across resolutions. This fills the documented gap in verification_lake_at_rest.md §5.

# Lake at Rest: Resolution Ladder

## Key Results

| dx | N | a_y/g | a_x/g | density error | pressure error |
|----|---|-------|-------|---------------|----------------|
| 0.04 | 70 | 2.05e-13 | 2.05e-13 | 7.17e-04 | 9.93e-02 |
| 0.02 | 300 | 7.30e-13 | 1.39e-12 | 2.53e-04 | 3.48e-02 |

## Convergence Order
- Density: 1.506 (2-pt, dx=0.04→0.02)
- Pressure: 1.514 (2-pt, dx=0.04→0.02)

## Verdict
PASS — profile errors converge at ~1.5 order, consistent with SPH cubic spline on regular lattice.
